description: A decentralized database model for p2p networks.
name: @tool-db/tool-db

scripts.clean:all: (rm -rf /tmp/jest_* || true) && (rm -rf _____peer_test-* || true) && (rm -rf test-* || true) && (rm -rf coverage) && npm run clean
scripts.reset:modules: (rm -rf node_modules || true) && (rm bun.lock || true) && (rm pnpm-lock.yaml || true) && (rm yarn.lock || true) && (rm package-lock.json || true)
scripts.update: bun x --node --yes npm-check-updates -u --peer -d --doctorInstall "npm run update:doctor:install" --doctorTest "npm run update:doctor:test"
scripts.update:doctor: bun run reset:modules && bun run update:doctor:install && bun run update:doctor:build
scripts.update:doctor:build: bun run clean:all && bun run build
scripts.update:doctor:test: bun run clean:all && bun run build && bun run test
